findings.highlight: cuts his enemy by simultaneously executing blows from different angles
findings.evidenceJa: 異なる円を描く刃を同時に放ち、敵を四散させる
findings.governingReading: simultaneously releases blades tracing different circles and scatters the enemy into pieces
findings.explanation: The technique’s distinct circular trajectories and bodily dismemberment are generalized to angles and cutting.

findings.highlight: three slashes
findings.evidenceJa: 三つの軌跡
findings.governingReading: three trajectories
findings.explanation: The simultaneous impossible paths central to the technique become ordinary slashing actions.

findings.highlight: a vertical slash
findings.evidenceJa: 頭上から股下までを断つ縦の線
findings.governingReading: a vertical line cutting from above the head through the crotch
findings.explanation: The exact lethal vertical axis disappears.

findings.highlight: the other two attacks will cut you even if one is blocked
findings.evidenceJa: 一つの軌跡を受けた瞬間に二つの軌跡が体を四散させる
findings.governingReading: the instant one trajectory strikes, the other two scatter the body
findings.explanation: Being struck by one path is changed into successfully blocking it.

findings.highlight: the longsword will reach out even if one retreats
findings.evidenceJa: 長刀は苦もなく逃げる胴を薙ぐ
findings.governingReading: the long sword will effortlessly sweep through the retreating torso
findings.explanation: The unavoidable bodily sweep is weakened to the sword merely reaching outward.

findings.highlight: The distance to attack Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを断ち切る距離
findings.governingReading: the distance from which to sever Saber
findings.explanation: The range’s immediately dismembering purpose is generalized.

findings.highlight: No matter how fast Saber may be
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの聖剣が速かろうと
findings.governingReading: no matter how fast Saber’s holy sword may be
findings.explanation: The comparison with Excalibur’s activation speed is reassigned to Saber’s general movement.

findings.highlight: many times faster
findings.evidenceJa: 遙かに上回る
findings.governingReading: far surpasses it
findings.explanation: An emphatic but unquantified speed advantage becomes a numerical magnitude claim.

findings.highlight: She feels despair from its precision and speed.
findings.evidenceJa: 二度目だというのに
findings.governingReading: even though this is her second time seeing it
findings.explanation: Saber’s renewed awe despite prior experience disappears.

findings.highlight: Only God would be able to block it.
findings.evidenceJa: 防ぐ事も返す事も許されまい
findings.governingReading: a non-divine being would be allowed neither to block nor return it
findings.explanation: The impossibility of counterattacking Tsubame Gaeshi disappears.

findings.highlight: There is a flash as small as a grain of sand.
findings.evidenceJa: 脳裏には砂粒ほどの微かな閃き
findings.governingReading: in her mind is a faint flash no larger than a grain of sand
findings.explanation: The insight’s mental and extremely tenuous nature is weakened.

findings.highlight: Saber must have figured out
findings.evidenceJa: 死角だと彼女は見抜いたのか
findings.governingReading: did she perceive that tiny gap as the technique’s blind spot?
findings.explanation: Narratorial uncertainty about Saber’s instantaneous perception becomes a confident assertion.

findings.highlight: since she experienced it once
findings.evidenceJa: 不完全ながらも一度燕返しを体験したが故に
findings.governingReading: because she had once experienced Tsubame Gaeshi, though in incomplete form
findings.explanation: The damaged earlier version that made prediction possible is omitted.

findings.highlight: she would be slashed
findings.evidenceJa: 輪切りにされる
findings.governingReading: she would be sliced crosswise into rings
findings.explanation: The precise gruesome consequence of mistiming the gap is generalized.

findings.highlight: she charged in with speed quicker than the attack
findings.evidenceJa: 剣士の抜刀を上回る速度での跳躍
findings.governingReading: a leap faster than the swordsman’s draw
findings.explanation: The benchmark is changed from Assassin’s sword-draw speed to an unspecified attack.

findings.highlight: The attack is the quickest
findings.evidenceJa: 返す刃は魔剣に至らぬまでも最速
findings.governingReading: the returning blade is at maximum speed, though short of the demonic technique
findings.explanation: The rapid return stroke after Tsubame Gaeshi becomes a generic attack.

findings.highlight: Blood from his lungs
findings.evidenceJa: 腑より逆流した血液
findings.governingReading: blood welling backward from his viscera
findings.explanation: The source of Assassin’s internal bleeding is incorrectly localized to his lungs.

findings.highlight: The golden-haired girl
findings.evidenceJa: 金の髪をした騎士
findings.governingReading: the golden-haired knight
findings.explanation: Assassin’s respectful perception of Saber as a knight is reduced to gender and appearance.

findings.highlight: She felt that her body would be slashed
findings.evidenceJa: 体を四つに断ち切られたと実感した
findings.governingReading: she felt her body had actually been cut into four
findings.explanation: A vivid felt experience of completed dismemberment becomes a generic future possibility.

findings.highlight: runs up the stairs
findings.evidenceJa: 全速で階段を駆け上がっていく
findings.governingReading: races up the stairs at full speed
findings.explanation: Saber’s urgency after Assassin releases her is weakened.

findings.highlight: something that even a sparrow could not avoid
findings.evidenceJa: 燕でさえ躱せぬもの
findings.governingReading: a technique even a swallow cannot evade
findings.explanation: The swallow completing the Tsubame Gaeshi wordplay is changed to a sparrow.

findings.highlight: He murmurs as if that was to be expected.
findings.evidenceJa: それも当然、と剣士は笑った。
findings.governingReading: the swordsman laughs that this is only natural
findings.explanation: Assassin’s quiet amused acceptance disappears.

findings.highlight: his bloodstained feet are vague
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮血に濡れた足下さえ希薄
findings.governingReading: even the space at his feet, soaked in fresh blood, is growing faint
findings.explanation: The fading manifestation around Assassin’s wound becomes nonsensical anatomy.

findings.highlight: He looks down at them and sits.
findings.evidenceJa: それを事も無げに見下ろし、さて、と石畳に腰を下ろす
findings.governingReading: he looks down at it without concern, says “well then,” and seats himself on the stones
findings.explanation: Assassin’s unruffled final manner and spoken transition disappear.

findings.highlight: when the flowers scatter, the wind stops, and the moon darkens
findings.evidenceJa: 花が散り鳥が消え風が止み、虚空の月さえ翳った頃
findings.governingReading: when flowers scatter, birds vanish, wind ceases, and even the moon in empty space grows dim
findings.explanation: The bird vanishes from the linked flower-bird-wind-moon sequence framing Assassin’s disappearance.
